notes.title: Editor Mode!
notes.notes:
Update: Flying Peep 🎉

It’s finally here! We’ve added a full Editor Mode that lets you customize your experience like never before:

Choose any level and start it with your selected outfit.
Toggle lights and music to set the perfect atmosphere.
Enjoy your favorite pose with your favorite style, and finally unlock the 10th achievement!
We’re beyond excited to share this update with you and can’t thank you enough for your support. It’s been an amazing journey, and we’re thrilled to make Flying Peep even more enjoyable for our players.

Cheers, and thank you all! 💖
